newsitem.title: USA: Piper holders approve changing fund policy.
newsitem.headline: Piper holders approve changing fund policy.

text.p: Piper Capital Management Inc said Thursday that shareholders approved policy changes for its Institutional Government Income Portfolio and Equity Strategy Fund.

For Institutional Government Income Portfolio, holders approved discontinuing the fund's policy limiting its investments to U.S. government securities. As a result, the fund's name will be changed to Intermediate Bond Fund, with a stock symbol of "PJBFX."
The fund, which had been closed to new investors since June 14, 1994, was reopened with a $250 minimum investment.

Equity Strategy Fund holders approved a new investment objective of long-term capital appreciation. The fund will be renamed Small Company Growth Fund and will be listed under the Nasdaq symbol "PJSCX."
The fund will seek to achieve its objective by investing primarily in common stocks of small-capitalization companies.
Piper Capital Management is a subsidiary of Piper Jaffray Cos Inc.
